checks.name: size: the small setup is under 1 MB
launch: it is started as a double-click would: no arguments, in its own folder, with no game beside it
cleanup: once the full setup has closed, and not before, the download is removed
api-asset: the release's TexasRevolutionSetup.exe is found by its exact name, and the small setup beside it is not taken
fallback: with the release's list unreachable, the stable latest-release address is downloaded and run
resume: a connection cut off part way is resumed from where it stopped, not begun again
size-mismatch: a download that is not the size the release gives is refused, not run, and not kept
digest-mismatch: a download whose SHA-256 is not GitHub's record of the setup is refused, not run, and not kept
filter-page: a network filter's page in place of the file is said to be the network, and nothing is run
disk-full: a download the disk cannot hold is refused before it starts, as not enough room
blocked: a downloaded setup Windows will not start is reported as that, and kept for IT to allow
unreachable: on the internet but unable to reach the download is said as that
offline: with Windows saying there is no internet, it says the computer is not connected
test-only: the download address can be changed only for a test, and only to this computer
